content: We denote the input article as $x=\lbrace x_1,x_2,x_3,\cdots ,x_M\rbrace $, and the corresponding headline as $y^*=\lbrace y_1^*,y_2^*,y_3^*,\cdots ,y_T^*\rbrace $, where $M$ is the number of tokens in an article and $T$ is the number of tokens in a headline.
